{{Top|leg}}
The '''thermoguard jumpsuit''' was an expensive form of [[Body glove/Legends|bodysuit]] that was developed to allow the wearer to become invisible to [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] and thermal scanners.

The thermoguard [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]] was equipped with an internal cooling unit that maintained an external temperature equal to that of the wearer's environment. This meant that, to infrared and thermal sensors and other devices, the wearer was virtually invisible.
